port.description: TCP port on which cwdaemon listens for client connections.

device.description: Device node for the key interface (serial or parallel port).

wpm.description: Morse code transmit speed in words per minute (WPM).

weight.description: Dit/dah timing weight (50 = straight key; lower = faster dits, higher = slower dits).

minspace.description: Minimum space between elements (dots/dashes) in milliseconds.

maxspace.description: Maximum space between characters in milliseconds.

maxwordspace.description: Maximum space between words in milliseconds.

audio_gain.description: Audio output gain (0–100), only applicable if cwdaemon is built with audio support.

allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client IP addresses (CIDR or single IP). If empty, all IPs are allowed.

denied_clients.description: List of denied client IP addresses (overrides allow list).

user.description: System user to run cwdaemon as (for security).

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for process management.

loglevel.description: Verbosity of logging (0 = silent, 1 = errors only, 4 = debug).

logfile.description: Path to the log file (use '-' to log to stdout).

invert_key.description: Invert the key signal (useful for certain hardware where low = key down).

use_dtr.description: Use DTR line instead of RTS for key control (serial interface only).
